# PHPMailer 7.1.1 (unmodified SMTP subset)

Source: https://github.com/PHPMailer/PHPMailer/releases/tag/v7.1.1
Pinned commit: `1bc1716a507a65e039d4ac9d9adebbbd0d346e15`.
Files `src/PHPMailer.php`, `src/SMTP.php`, `src/Exception.php` are included here
without changes, alongside upstream LICENSE (LGPL 2.1).
Manual loading follows upstream's supported non-Composer setup. No OAuth,
examples, executable installers or language packs are needed by this application.

To update: review upstream release/security notes, replace all three files and
license together, update this version/provenance, test SMTP TLS/authentication,
message generation and queue behavior. Never disable certificate verification.
The Hostinger builder includes only these explicitly listed private files.
